scripts.// start: Launches Claude Code with plugins/jookoi-dev loaded from disk for this session only. Nothing is installed. Use to try a skill change before committing. Restart to pick up edits.
scripts.// install:plugin: Installs the plugin from this local checkout: registers the repo as a marketplace, then installs jookoi-dev@jookoi-ai-market. Persists across sessions. Use on a new machine, or to install from the working copy instead of GitHub.
scripts.install:plugin: claude plugin marketplace add . && claude plugin install jookoi-dev@jookoi-ai-market
scripts.// sync: Copies the latest skills from plugins/*/skills/ into the folders in SKILL_TARGETS (.env, defaults to ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills; see .env.example). Run after pulling, or after editing a skill here. Skips identical skills, and skips (exit 1) any target copy that is newer than this repo's unless you pass `-- --force`. Preview with `-- --dry-run`. Never deletes other skills in the targets.
scripts.// sync:force: Same as sync, but overwrites target copies even when they are newer than this repo's. Use when sync reports skipped skills and you want the repo version to win.
scripts.// update-skills: The one command to run after adding, renaming or editing a skill (and before finishing, per AGENTS.md). Auto-fixes missing SKILL.md metadata, runs `claude plugin validate` on every plugin and the marketplace manifest, then re-audits. If README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md or plugin.json still miss a skill, prints the problems plus a ready-made agent prompt and exits 1. Exits 0 when nothing is left. Needs the `claude` CLI on PATH.
